# Avyakt Murli Reader

> Avyakt Murli Reader is a web reader for Hindi Avyakt Murlis. It is dedicated to Brahma Kumaris students who want an easy, accessible way to read Avyakt Vaani.

It is for students of Brahma Kumaris. The reader interface is in English. The murli text is in Hindi.

## Product
- 49 Hindi Avyakt Vaani volumes covering 1969 to 2017
- Year picker to open a book
- Tap the sides or swipe to turn pages
- Tap the center to show or hide the menu
- Font-size toggle for larger text
- Light and dark appearance
- How-to-read guide in English and Gujarati

## Pages
- [Home](https://avyakt-murli-reader.devagn.com): Read Avyakt Murlis
- [About](https://avyakt-murli-reader.devagn.com/about): About the reader, book count, years, and contact
